explanation: To stop sleeping.
example_english: I wake up at seven every morning.
example_somali: Subax kasta toddobada ayaan toosaa.

explanation: To leave your bed after sleeping.
example_english: She gets up early for work.
example_somali: Waxay shaqada awgeed goor hore sariirta uga kacdaa.

explanation: To start a machine, light, or device.
example_english: Please turn on the light.
example_somali: Fadlan nalka shid.

explanation: To stop a machine, light, or device.
example_english: Turn off the stove before you leave.
example_somali: Shooladda dami ka hor intaadan bixin.

explanation: To collect someone or something.
example_english: Can you pick up the medicine on your way home?
example_somali: Daawada ma soo qaadi kartaa markaad guriga u socoto?

explanation: To take someone or something to a place and leave them there.
example_english: I will drop off the documents at the office.
example_somali: Dukumentiyada ayaan xafiiska geyn doonaa oo ka tagi doonaa.

explanation: To try to find someone or something.
example_english: I am looking for my wallet.
example_somali: Waxaan raadinayaa boorsadayda lacagta.

explanation: To take care of someone or something.
example_english: My sister looks after the children after school.
example_somali: Walaashay carruurta ayay daryeeshaa dugsiga ka dib.

explanation: To place clothes, shoes, or accessories on your body.
example_english: Put on your coat; it is cold outside.
example_somali: Jaakaddaada xiro; bannaanka waa qabow.

explanation: To remove clothes, shoes, or accessories from your body.
example_english: Please take off your shoes before you come in.
example_somali: Fadlan kabaha iska bixi ka hor intaadan gudaha iman.

explanation: To learn information you did not know before.
example_english: I need to find out when the clinic opens.
example_somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan ogaado goorta xarunta caafimaadku furanto.

explanation: To stop trying to do something.
example_english: Do not give up; your English is improving.
example_somali: Ha ka harin; Ingiriisigaagu wuu soo hagaagayaa.

explanation: To continue doing something.
example_english: Carry on with the exercise after the break.
example_somali: Nasashada ka dib layliga sii wad.

explanation: To enter a room or building.
example_english: Please come in and take a seat.
example_somali: Fadlan soo gal oo kursi fadhiiso.

explanation: To leave a place, often to do something outside.
example_english: We can go out for tea after class.
example_somali: Fasalka ka dib shaah ayaan u bixi karnaa.

explanation: To return to a place.
example_english: Please come back tomorrow morning.
example_somali: Fadlan berri subax soo noqo.

explanation: To return to a previous place.
example_english: I need to go back to the shop for my receipt.
example_somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dukaanka ugu noqdo rasiidkayga.

explanation: To move into a sitting position.
example_english: Please sit down in the waiting area.
example_somali: Fadlan fariiso aagga sugitaanka.

explanation: To rise to your feet.
example_english: Stand up slowly if you feel dizzy.
example_somali: Si tartiib ah u istaag haddii aad wareer dareento.

explanation: To write information so you can remember it.
example_english: Write down the address before you leave.
example_somali: Cinwaanka qor ka hor intaadan bixin.

explanation: To complete a form by writing information in it.
example_english: Please fill in this form at reception.
example_somali: Fadlan foomkan ku buuxi soo-dhoweynta.

explanation: To write your name or enter your details when you arrive.
example_english: You need to sign in before the meeting.
example_somali: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad is diiwaangeliso ka hor shirka.

explanation: To tell a hotel, clinic, airport, or event that you have arrived.
example_english: We need to check in at the hotel before dinner.
example_somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan hoteelka iska diiwaangelinno cashada ka hor.

explanation: To leave a hotel officially or to look at something.
example_english: We check out of the hotel at eleven.
example_somali: Hoteelka waxaan ka baxnaa kow iyo tobanka.

explanation: To put on clothing or shoes to see if they fit.
example_english: Can I try on these shoes?
example_somali: Kabahan ma tijaabin karaa?

explanation: To return money that you borrowed.
example_english: I will pay you back on Friday.
example_somali: Jimcaha ayaan lacagta kuu celin doonaa.

explanation: To have no more of something left.
example_english: We ran out of milk this morning.
example_somali: Caanihii ayaa naga dhammaaday subaxdan.

explanation: To stay somewhere until someone or something arrives.
example_english: Please wait for the doctor in this room.
example_somali: Fadlan qolka kan ku sug dhakhtarka.

explanation: To request something.
example_english: Ask for a receipt when you pay.
example_somali: Rasiid codso markaad lacag bixiso.

explanation: To give attention to a sound or person speaking.
example_english: Listen to the teacher's example first.
example_somali: Marka hore dhageyso tusaalaha macallinka.

explanation: To discuss a subject.
example_english: Can we talk about my work schedule?
example_somali: Jadwalkayga shaqada ma ka hadli karnaa?

explanation: To look after someone who needs help.
example_english: She cares for her mother at home.
example_somali: Hooyadeed ayay guriga ku daryeeshaa.

explanation: To return something to a place or person.
example_english: Bring back the library book next week.
example_somali: Buugga maktabadda soo celi toddobaadka dambe.

explanation: To return something by sending it.
example_english: I need to send back the wrong size.
example_somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan dib u diro cabbirka khaldan.

explanation: To phone someone again later.
example_english: The nurse will call back this afternoon.
example_somali: Kalkaaliyaha ayaa galabta dib u wici doona.

explanation: To reduce speed.
example_english: Please slow down when you speak.
example_somali: Fadlan hadalkaaga gaabi.

explanation: To do something more quickly.
example_english: We need to hurry up or we will miss the bus.
example_somali: Waa inaan degdegnaa haddii kale baska ayaan seegi doonnaa.

explanation: To start living in a new home.
example_english: We move in on Saturday morning.
example_somali: Sabti subax ayaan guriga cusub degaynaa.

explanation: To stop living in a home and leave it.
example_english: They will move out at the end of the month.
example_somali: Waxay ka guuri doonaan dhammaadka bisha.

explanation: To make a place clean and tidy.
example_english: Let's clean up the kitchen before guests arrive.
example_somali: Aan nadiifinno jikada ka hor inta martidu imaan.

explanation: To prepare equipment or arrange something so it can be used.
example_english: Can you set up the microphone for the online class?
example_somali: Makarafoonka ma u diyaarin kartaa fasalka internetka?

explanation: To enter a website or app with your username and password.
example_english: Log in before the online lesson starts.
example_somali: Gal nidaamka ka hor inta casharka internetku bilaaban.

explanation: To leave a website or app safely.
example_english: Log out when you finish using the computer.
example_somali: Ka bax nidaamka markaad dhamayso isticmaalka kombiyuutarka.

explanation: To produce a paper copy from a computer or phone.
example_english: Please print out the application form.
example_somali: Fadlan daabac foomka codsiga.

explanation: To wait for a short time, especially on the phone.
example_english: Hold on, I will check your appointment.
example_somali: Sug, ballantaada ayaan hubinayaa.
